ideas.title: Investigating Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent surge in Medicaid fraud cases in Minnesota, including the $11M case and the Feeding Our Future fraud scheme.
questions: What is the scope of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How are investigators addressing the issue?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a systemic issue with Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, and could lead to further investigations and reforms.
